source_notes.scope: NYC-only research candidates for architecture and built-environment events, roughly 2008-2026.
source_notes.duplicate_check_method: Searched data/manual_drops/architecture_milestones/architecture_milestones_2008_2026.json for city_id=nyc and candidate names, addresses, districts, and common aliases before writing this temporary file.
source_notes.preferred_sources_used: Official NYC HDC/HPD-linked press releases and NYC Landmarks Preservation Commission public pages were prioritized. One 227 Duffield Street candidate uses an NYC Community Affairs newsletter plus notes that the LPC designation report is the better ingestion source.
source_notes.date_policy: Dates are source publication/ribbon-cutting/designation dates unless status_date_basis says otherwise. No construction, occupancy, or causal claim is inferred beyond the cited source wording.
source_notes.geometry_policy: Latitude/longitude values are approximate candidate points for review only. Multi-site portfolios and historic districts should use source polygons, address lists, or multiple child records before atlas ingestion.
source_notes.license_and_terms_note: These candidates cite URLs and factual metadata only. Review NYC.gov, HDC, and LPC terms and any dataset-specific license before redistributing larger excerpts, images, or derived geometries.
